runs.title: Hauler 路线缓存与 CPU 优化
runs.summary: Implemented and deployed the requested CPU changes: bounded static Hauler route caching, short delivery-port lease retention, and reusePath extended from 15 to 50 ticks. Empty-pickup waiting/backoff remains intentionally unchanged. Post-deploy code parity passed; the available monitor snapshot shows the new build and counters, while its Tick did not advance during the observation interval, so a long stable CPU comparison remains a follow-up measurement.
